THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
STUDIO
131
STUDY 014
Red Headband Pop
Rights check
Source: 5031.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
A vertical close-up portrait of an original young woman
with long, straight black hair and full bangs, wearing a
glossy red satin headband across the top of her head.
She wears a red sheer puff-sleeve top with a small
rounded collar over a pale pink undershirt, with the
sleeves gathered at the shoulders. She sits with her
knees drawn up, partly visible at the bottom of the
frame, with white knee socks. Her skin is pale and
luminous, with soft rosy blush on the cheeks and
glossy, coral-pink lips. Her expression is calm and
slightly intense, with a direct gaze toward the camera.
Soft, flat studio lighting against a dusty pink seamless
backdrop, a palette of cherry red, blush pink, and
cream white. Playful, graphic, and pastel, in the style of
a retro-inspired beauty or fashion editorial.
Playful, graphic, pastel
WORKING NOTES
- The red headband and dusty pink backdrop create the
color contrast; keep both specific.
- Adding "soft film grain" gives a more vintage print look.
Try this: Add soft film grain for a vintage print look.
